turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    C1 --> C2[Compress to floor content]
    C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content and function]
    C3 --> C4[Locate operative sentence]
    C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and flags]
    C5 --> C6[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    C6 --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt or task| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
    D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for mode]
    D2 --> D1
    D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    D3 --> D4{Floor passes?}
    D4 -->|No, three or fewer gaps| D5[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    D4 -->|No, four or more gaps| D6[Ask three largest gaps]
    D6 --> D7[State assumptions for the rest]
    D5 --> D8[Wait for answer]
    D7 --> D8
    D8 --> D3
    D4 -->|Yes| D9[Compress the prompt]
    D9 --> D10{Cut removed a specification?}
    D10 -->|Yes| D11[Revert the decorative or destructive cut]
    D11 --> D9
    D10 -->|No| D12{Two consecutive empty cuts?}
    D12 -->|No| D13{Floor still passes?}
    D13 -->|Yes| D9
    D13 -->|No| D14[Return the last passing version]
    D12 -->|Yes| D15[State that the contract is minimal]
    D14 --> D16[Output the PROVIDE template]
    D15 --> D16
    D16 --> E{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}

    E -->|Keep negotiating| D9
    E -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| F{Execution tools available?}
    F -->|No| F1[Gate stays closed. Do not fake a run.]
    F1 --> Z
    F -->|Yes| G[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    G --> H[Execute exactly as written]
    H --> I{Result}
    I -->|Success| J[Done]
    I -->|Floor item fails| K[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    K --> D9
```
